verdict.key_diagnostic_summary: MATHEMATICALLY UNDERDETERMINED & NON-UNIQUE (Fails p < 0.001 anti-hallucination gate): In the 23 connected circular/cylinder Gulf-orbit seals (G_gulf_cc; 24 total incl. disconnected 5557.1), 35/53 signs (66.04%) are singletons with ZERO cross-seal ties (37/55 = 67.27% across all 24), leaving incidence-rank DOF = 30 even WITH a known word per seal! Exact AC-3 percolation on a realistic combinatorial onomastic manifold shows collapsing the 18-sign shared core (P>=95%) requires k*=18 highest-degree bilingual anchors (44 random-order) in a 100%-attested closed archive, and k*=18 highest-degree (None random-order) in a realistic 75%-attested open-vocab archive (full 53 signs: k*=53/53). Without a bilingual (k=0), collapsing the core requires m*=None additional cross-linked circular foreign seals (m*=50 w/ k=2, m*=50 w/ k=4, m*=50 w/ k=6), while coupon-collector elimination of singletons across all 53 Gulf signs alone requires ~95–132 seals.
